title: Im the one who gave Grok Bot 20K and asked for 5 to 10% a day.
author: Moedawi85
selftext:
So the next day it went negative so had to adjust few things but Groks bot suggested to start trading 10 or 10:30 and I said unless miss most of the peaks and u won't hit ur goal but go for it since it needed a stabilized readings and that would be mostly accurate around 10AM it won but not hitting the goal.

The 2 photos shows the 1st day win, 2nd day loss, 3rd day trading at 10AM and the loss from yesterday.
